releaseNotesMarkdown:
### valkey-io/valkey (valkey/valkey)

### [`v9.1.3`](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/releases/tag/9.1.3)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/compare/9.1.2...9.1.3)

## Valkey 9.1.3  -  Released Mon 26 October 2026

Upgrade urgency SECURITY: This release includes security fixes we recommend you apply as soon as possible.

##### Security Fixes

- GHSA-f4q9-j22m-xqq9: Fix a heap buffer overflow in cluster Pub/Sub message construction that could allow an authenticated client to potentially execute arbitrary code by publishing an oversized message by [@​roshkhatri](https://redirect.github.com/roshkhatri) ([#​5030](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/5030))

##### Bug Fixes

- Fix stream commands that mutate consumer-group or PEL state (`XGROUP`, `XSETID`, `XREADGROUP`, `XACK`, `XCLAIM`, `XAUTOCLAIM`) not triggering `WATCH` and client-side tracking invalidation by [@​Tarte12](https://redirect.github.com/Tarte12) ([#​3459](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3459))
- Reject module write commands while the server is paused for writes, preventing a crash from module timer callbacks during `CLIENT PAUSE WRITE` or `CLUSTER FAILOVER` by [@​smkher](https://redirect.github.com/smkher) ([#​3645](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/3645))
- Fix event loop busy-spinning on virtual machines by not using raw TSC for the monotonic clock when the kernel clocksource is not tsc by [@​quanyeyang](https://redirect.github.com/quanyeyang) ([#​4707](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4707))
- Fix a crash in `ValkeyModule_HashHasStringRef` on a missing or expired field and correct wrong return values in the hash stringRef module APIs by [@​ShubhamTaple](https://redirect.github.com/ShubhamTaple) ([#​4504](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4504))
- Fix a server abort on a RESTORE payload declaring a string length that overflows the allocation size; such payloads are now rejected as bad data by [@​enjoy-binbin](https://redirect.github.com/enjoy-binbin) ([#​4733](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4733))
- Fix ZINTER/ZINTERSTORE returning input-order-dependent scores when a weighted term is 0\*inf; a NaN weighted score now counts as 0, matching ZUNION by [@​leomurillo](https://redirect.github.com/leomurillo) ([#​4997](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4997))
- Clear a stale primary-failure gossip flag on replicas so later failovers don't incorrectly skip the election delay by [@​charsyam](https://redirect.github.com/charsyam) ([#​4533](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4533))
- Correct `ValkeyModule_FreeModuleUser`, `ValkeyModule_ACLAddLogEntry` and `ValkeyModule_ACLAddLogEntryByUserName` declarations to return int as implemented, fixing undefined behavior on targets with strict call signature checks by [@​rainsupreme](https://redirect.github.com/rainsupreme) ([#​4676](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4676))
- valkey-check-aof now recognizes RDB base files with the `VALKEY` signature instead of misreporting a valid multipart AOF as invalid by [@​sarthakaggarwal97](https://redirect.github.com/sarthakaggarwal97) ([#​4739](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4739))
- Fix module commands that access undeclared keys in other slots reading or writing the wrong slot in cluster mode, and aborting in debug builds by [@​patrickswedish](https://redirect.github.com/patrickswedish) ([#​4424](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4424))
- Reject relative expire times in `SET`/`GETEX`, `RESTORE`, and `ValkeyModule_SetExpire` that overflow when added to the current time, preventing server aborts from negative expires by [@​madolson](https://redirect.github.com/madolson) ([#​4880](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4880))
- `HDEL`, `HGETDEL`, `HPERSIST`, and `HEXPIRE` no longer propagate fields they treat as expired, preventing replica and AOF-reload divergence by [@​xdk-amz](https://redirect.github.com/xdk-amz) ([#​4772](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4772))
- Fix a server crash when loading an ACL file containing a selector with an unmatched parenthesis by [@​magic-peach](https://redirect.github.com/magic-peach) ([#​4214](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4214))
- Fix a segfault on Alpine/musl when Lua is built as a module, caused by a symbol clash on an internal clock function by [@​mohammedgqudah](https://redirect.github.com/mohammedgqudah) ([#​4270](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4270))
- `COPY` of a hash now includes expired-but-unreaped fields so their deletion is propagated and replicas stay in sync by [@​pirate329](https://redirect.github.com/pirate329) ([#​4939](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4939))
- Restore acceptance of hexadecimal float sorted set scores (such as `0x10`), keeping replication and AOF replay compatible with Valkey 9.0 by [@​quanyeyang](https://redirect.github.com/quanyeyang) ([#​4875](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4875))
- Sorted set range commands with a negative `LIMIT` offset now return an empty result instead of a spurious element on btree-encoded keys by [@​xiaocj](https://redirect.github.com/xiaocj) ([#​4637](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4637))
- Fix listpack encoding incompatibility that caused RDB load and replication failures for entries of certain lengths between 9.0 and 9.1.x by [@​jjuleslasarte](https://redirect.github.com/jjuleslasarte) ([#​4819](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4819))
- Fix atomic slot migration not replicating evictions on the import target, which let replicas grow far past `maxmemory` by [@​shanezx-sc](https://redirect.github.com/shanezx-sc) ([#​4920](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4920))
- Redact error text in server logs when `hide-user-data-from-log` is enabled, so command arguments no longer leak into logs by [@​zackcam](https://redirect.github.com/zackcam) ([#​4815](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4815))
- Fix `HSETEX` and `HGETEX` failing to parse their arguments when the key is named `fields` by [@​sebxt](https://redirect.github.com/sebxt) ([#​4945](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4945))
- Fix cluster config saving to avoid publishing truncated `nodes.conf` files, losing the startup lock after the first save, and failing every save on SMB filesystems such as Azure Files; the lock now lives on a separate `nodes.conf.lock` file by [@​KewangZhili](https://redirect.github.com/KewangZhili) ([#​4489](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4489))
- Fix `LSET` on 64-bit builds silently modifying the wrong element for out-of-range indexes instead of returning an index out of range error by [@​charsyam](https://redirect.github.com/charsyam) ([#​4823](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4823))
- Fix atomic slot migration with `cluster-databases` > 1 applying writes made during the snapshot to the wrong database on the target by [@​pirate329](https://redirect.github.com/pirate329) ([#​4952](https://redirect.github.com/valkey-io/valkey/issues/4952))

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey/compare/9.1.2...9.1.3>
